@ a child with a delay at sample / 4 gives its value at the ticks of the parent, across the calls
- the value of a child is the value of its body written in the parent, whatever the cuts of the run
@ two instances of one child keep their own delays
@ the init argument of a child is the first value of its delay, and a reset gives it again
@ a part computed at the tick of a child is computed at the tick: the frames between read its field
@ a child and its parent tick at the same ratio, at the same frames
@ a child that ticks at sample / 2 beside a parent that ticks at sample / 4
@ a grandchild is in the stages of the parent too, with the stage of its parent
@ a stage that two levels of children below the parent have is in the parent too
